description.en: At a glance, high-schooler Moran Baek appears to be a beautiful girl who’s perfect in every way… or so it would seem. In reality, she is an exiled demon who has been trapped in a human body for over 5,000 years. When she learns that she is still unable to use her demonic powers despite finishing her exile, Moran despairs and struggles to find a way to become a demon again. One day, she accidentally discovers that doing a good deed restores her powers, and sets out to find a way to keep doing good deeds so she can return to her devilish ways.

After landing her dream job in TV, Doah can't be more excited… until she loses her loved ones in a shocking twist of events. While looking for a new place to stay, she stumbles across a promising ad for a share house and meets the Landlord, an oddball who seems like he's from another planet. But the shabby old-fashioned house is completely different from what Doah expected, and so are its two strange tenants: a prudish Joseon-era scholar from 1777 and a jolly Modern Boy from 1930. What's more, the Landlord seems determined to keep them from leaving for some mysterious reason. What crazy adventures await Doah in this house that transcends time, and will her rotten luck turn around for the better?

description.en:
It contains nine one-shot romance manhwa by Wann.  
  
Return of Princess Rouana – Asha was sent by her master Cayan, the so-called "evil sorcerer," to send a message to the Royal Court that Princess Rouana will be returning home. Forty years ago, it was believed that the sorcerer Cayan kidnapped Princess Rouana. However, when Asha starts spending more time in the castle, she finds the place strangely familiar. Slowly, she discovers the secret Cayan wants her to find.  
  
Believe Ye Your Eyes? – Sei is a guy with a face so beautiful that he can easily get any girl. Unfortunately, after a certain accident, he cannot see women – yes, all women are invisible to him. Of course, he couldn't care less since being able to have a physical relationship with them is enough for him. Seeing them means trouble because they may become special to him. One day, Sei notices something – he can see one woman, the annoying girl that lives next door whom he never bothers to pay attention to. Strangely, he is the only person who is invisible to her. Slowly, he starts investigating her, but gradually, he starts falling in love with her…  
  
A Short Game About A Chance Encounter – This is the story of two people meeting each other by chance and falling in love. The manhwa itself is put together in the most narrative, where the narrator rewinds the story after each turning point of the story and retells it with a switch of scenario and possibilities. This is really a simple story told in the most unusual method ever.  
  
Automation – 1005 is an android that was "born" with defects: she opened her eyes while being manufactured and she can dream. Yet, she isn't the only one. Shaa, known as 1004, also opened her eyes from the beginning. The two become close and they teach each other emotions that they are not suppose to have as androids. One day Shaa overhears her master saying that androids are implanted with the memories of humans, and she realizes the she and 1005 are not actually "faulty products"….  
  
A Cold – A simple story about a couple breaking up due to a minor fight. After they break up, the two of them can't help regretting it. She takes on his habit of eating ice mix in the middle of winter, while he, who has never gotten sick, now has a cold. The two continue to take on each other's habits until one day…  
  
Purple Eyes – Ruben was born with the ability to make accurate predictions and read people's mind. He and his brother, Dave, and his brother girlfriend, Pat, are stuck in a ghost town when their car breaks down, and have no choice but to stay there for the night. There, Ruben discovers the history of the ghost town when he starts recalling the memories of an innocent girl who burnt to death at a witch trial. Ever since then the town has suffered from a curse, where every single girl in the village perished after hallucinations and high fever…  
  
Leucadian – There was a famous Greek poetess who jumped off a cliff and committed suicide after she was rejected by her beloved. That cliff is called Leucadian. Leucadian has become a legend where it is rumored that anyone, with a broken heart, who jumps off the Leucadian Cliff and survives will recover from his or her loss. On a cruise trip on the Mediterranean Sea, Len meets the girl of his dream, but she is always alone, staring into the ocean. It turns out that she came to the Leucadian Cliff with a broken heart…  
  
Mint Flavor – She and Gia have been best friends for 10 years and they know everything about each other. Gia has just come back from a trip to Rome with her boyfriend and they haven't seen each other for two weeks. She goes over to her place first thing when she gets back to Seoul and finds out that Gia has just broken up with her boyfriend. Together they discover that their feelings for each other are more than just as friends….  
  
A Flying Lesson – When Herman runs away from her tutor, she picks up a bird who considers her as his mommy. He's not just any bird - he's a human with wings. Herman becomes attached to the little birdy, Lilda, and is determined to teach Lilda how to fly…

description.en: Dajeong has lived with Dr. Lee Sehyeon for as long as he can remember, but his memories are muddled and don't go back very far. All he knows for certain is that the doctor must give him an injection every day, his diet can only consist of raw meat, and he is forbidden from venturing outdoors. He is, in fact, the last surviving zombie from an outbreak that humanity managed to contain a decade ago, and was the product of an experiment that Dr. Lee managed to rescue him from before he could be disposed of. The doctor knows that he can't keep Dajeong hidden forever, just as he knows that Dajeong's questions about why he is "sick" will one day need to be answered. He slowly begins introducing Dajeong to the outside world, but things become more complicated when his undead patient begins to fall in love with him.
The Damned Devil's Army are rampaging around the world and the only person who can stop them is the Earth Warrior.

description.de: So manch einer würde denken, dass Asina als die Tochter von Cromwalls Erzherzhog ein Leben führt, das nichts zu wünschen übrig lässt. Sie selbst sieht das allerdings ganz anders und entscheidet kurzerhand, von Zuhause wegzulaufen – in die wunderschöne, aber gleichzeitig lebensbedrohliche Wüste. Zu ihrem Unglück ist die erste Person, auf die sie trifft, niemand Geringeres als Sihad Zain Behdad, der König der feindlichen Nation Pesian. Zuerst wirft er sie ins Gefängnis, weil er sie für verdächtig hält, aber als er sie wenig später auf frischer Tat bei einem Fluchtversuch ertappt, nimmt er sie ohne Weiteres in seinen Harem auf! Kann Asina es schaffen, ihre Herkunft geheim zu halten und dem Sihad entkommen? Oder wird sie dem Charme des unnahbaren Königs am Ende doch verfallen?
description.en: One would think Asina has it all as the daughter of Cromwall's archduke, but a serious case of the travel bug has her ditch her comfortable estate for the beautiful but deadly desert. Unfortunately, the first person she meets there happens to be Sihad Zain Behdad, the king of Cromwall's enemy nation, Pesian. First, he throws her in prison because he finds her suspicious. Then, he captures her when she breaks out and throws her in his harem! Can Asina hide her identity long enough to escape from the Sihad, or will she fall prey to the aloof king's unexpected charm?
description.fr:
Fille de l'archiduc de Cromwall, Asina semble mener une vie parfaite. Mais une soif d'aventure irrésistible la pousse à quitter son quotidien confortable et l'entraîne dans le magnifique mais dangereux désert de la mort. Son aventure prend un tournant inattendu lorsqu'elle y rencontre Sihad Zain Behdad, le redoutable roi de Pesian, ennemi juré de sa nation. D'abord jetée en prison à cause de son attitude suspecte, sa tentative d'évasion manquée la mène à être enfermée dans le harem royal. Asina arrivera-t-elle à dissimuler son identité assez longtemps pour échapper au Sihad ou succombera-t-elle au charme inattendu de ce roi mystérieux ?
___
On pourrait croire qu'Asina a tout pour elle en tant que fille de l'archiduc de Cromwall, mais un sérieux cas de virus du voyage l'amène à quitter son confortable domaine pour le désert, aussi beau que mortel. Malheureusement, la première personne qu'elle rencontre là-bas est Sihad Zain Behdad, le roi de la nation ennemie de Cromwall, Pesian. Il la jette d'abord en prison parce qu'il la trouve suspecte. Ensuite, il la capture lorsqu'elle s'évade et la jette dans son harem ! Asina pourra-t-elle cacher son identité suffisamment longtemps pour échapper au Sihad, ou sera-t-elle la proie du charme inattendu du roi distant ?

생명이 살지 않는 모래사막 한복판에서 마주친 한 남자.

description.ru: Казалось бы, у Асины — дочери эрцгерцога Кромволла — есть всё на свете, но необузданная жажда приключений заставляет покинуть уютное поместье в пользу прекрасной, но полной опасностей пустыни. К сожалению, первым человеком, которого она там встречает, является Сихад Зейн Бехдад, король вражеской нации Кромволла, Песиан. Сначала она попадает в тюрьму, так как мужчина счёл её подозрительной. description.en:
I was reborn 14 years before the original novel began—as the empire’s strongest archmage.

All I remember is a single plea: “Protect them.” So I stayed low, planning not to interfere with the story’s happy ending.

But then I met the young Fourth Prince, the future tyrant shaped by tragedy. Gaunt and neglected, the child had never even tasted warm soup.

I couldn’t just watch.

“Your Highness, would you like to become my disciple?”

Twelve years later, the once-abused prince is a grown man—still my loyal student, and now hiding bold feelings for his master.
description.id:
Seorang archmage bereinkarnasi 14 tahun sebelum dimulainya cerita asli dan memutuskan untuk diam di wilayah kekaisaran. Di istana, ia bertemu Pangeran Sa—penjahat utama yang kelak menjadi tiran karena masa kecilnya yang penuh penganiayaan. Tersentuh oleh penderitaan sang pangeran kecil, sang penyihir menawarkan untuk menjadikannya murid. Ia bertekad memberi akhir yang bahagia juga bagi penjahat muda itu. Dua belas tahun kemudian, Pangeran Sa tumbuh menjadi pria dewasa dan murid setia sang penyihir, menyimpan perasaan terlarang padanya. Kisah mereka penuh keajaiban, perlindungan, dan cinta yang berkembang perlahan.

---
Aku bereinkarnasi ke dalam cerita, 14 tahun sebelum kisah aslinya dimulai. Sebagai penyihir agung terkuat di seluruh kekaisaran. […tolong lindungi dia.] Kalimat itu saja yang kuingat. Apakah maksudnya agar aku menjaga akhir dari cerita ini, karena novel ini berhenti di tengah jalan? Ini novel romansa, pada akhirnya pemeran utamanya pasti berakhir bahagia, kan? Masih lama sebelum cerita dimulai, jadi aku akan tinggal diam di wilayahku. Tapi kemudian aku bertemu dengannya di istana kekaisaran. Sang tokoh antagonis utama dalam cerita, Pangeran Keempat yang kelak menjadi tiran karena masa kecilnya yang penuh penderitaan. Tubuh kurus kering seperti binatang, dengan tulang-tulang menonjol. Memang menyedihkan… tapi kalau aku mengubah alur ceritanya, informasi yang kuketahui bisa menjadi tidak berguna. [Anak itu bahkan belum pernah mencicipi sup hangat.] Kalau cuma memberinya makan… seharusnya tak masalah, kan? Namun— “Yang Mulia Pangeran Keempat, rasanya enak bisa bersih-bersih, bukan?” “……” [Baginya, kekerasan dan pengabaian adalah hal yang biasa.] Saat aku melihatnya menggigil diam seolah sudah terbiasa disiram air dingin tengah malam oleh pelayan… Aku memutuskan. “Yang Mulia… bersediakah menjadi muridku?” Aku akan memberimu akhir yang bahagia juga. “Yang Mulia, kalau terus menatap seperti tadi, nanti ketahuan, lho? Oleh beliau yang bertindak seperti walimu itu.” “Bagus kalau begitu, Tuan Markis.” Dua belas tahun telah berlalu, dan kini Pangeran Keempat yang telah dewasa tetap menjadi murid penyihir agung. “Tolong, semoga beliau menyadarinya… perasaan tak pantas yang kusimpan untuknya.” "Baiklah, aku akan menjaga agar cerita tetap sesuai naskah. Tapi, yang bahagia bukan hanya dua tokoh utama!" Penyihir overpower Reina dan murid-murid tercintanya datang menyapa kalian!
description.ko:
원작이 시작되기 14년 전으로 빙의해버렸다.
제국 내 가장 강하다는 대마법사로.

[…를 지켜줘.]

기억나는 건 이 말 하나.
연재 중지된 소설 속이니 결말을 지켜달라는 건가?
로맨스 소설. 어차피 결말은 주인공들의 해피엔딩이겠지.
원작이 시작되려면 아직 멀었으니까 영지에서 조용히 있자.

그러다 황궁에서 마주쳐버렸다.
소설 속 메인 악당, 어린 시절의 불행 서사로 폭군이 되어버리는 사 황자와.
짐승 같은 몰골. 뼈마디가 드러난 앙상한 몸.
안쓰럽지만 등장인물의 서사를 바꾸면 내가 아는 정보와 달라질 수 있으니-.

[아이는 따뜻한 수프를 먹어 본 적이 없었다.]

밥 먹이는 것 정도는 괜찮겠지……?


그러나.

“사 황자 전하, 깨끗해져서 좋으시죠?”
“…….”

[아이에게 학대와 방치는 일상이었다.]

한밤중, 찬물을 끼얹는 시종이 익숙하다는 듯 조용히 벌벌 떠는 아이를 본 순간 결심했다.

“황자님. 제 제자가 되시겠습니까?”

너도 해피엔딩을 맞게 해줄게.

= = =

“전하, 아까처럼 보고 계시면 들킵니다? 보호자 노릇을 하시는 그분께요.”
“잘됐네요. 후작.”

12년이 흘러, 성인이 된 사 황자는 여전히 대마법사의 제자로 남아있었다.

“제발, 들켜줬으면 하거든요.”

스승에게 품은 발칙한 자신의 마음을 알아차린 채.

My father died when I was small, and my mother was a first-ranked maid, who left me in the charge of my grandparents. The last time I met her was when she was 36.  
Out of curiosity, I plunge into the world of maids. I wait on young master Rain, and study at the school for maids. And master Rain's brother… he is… what's my feeling for him anyway? Could it be love?  
  
And just you wait, I will be Cinderella.  
  
Note: Cinderella is not a reference to Cinderella from fairytale, but is a title given to the best maid through a rigorous competition.

College is expensive. After his big brother sacrificed their life savings to pay for his tuition, the last thing Sujin wanted was to burden his new roommate. Little did he know, she was a beautiful older woman?! Minuk, famous writer, ex best friend of Sujin’s brother, and also very gay. She’s letting Sujin stay on one condition: don’t fall in love. More specific: with her. Can he do it? What is her past with his older brother? And why was Sujin chased out of the last college he entered…

With their parents suddenly deciding to live in the countryside, Daeyoung, who went down to the countryside with his elder brother, Daesu, met the sons of their dad's friend, Sunghyeon and Gangjin.

"Daesu's brother is the spare."
"Okay, let him be the goal keeper."

When he was younger, he could still stand alongside his elder brothers as a spare.
A three years age gap was nothing, but the distance between them grew.

Then, one day.
Hearing that the elder brothers were hanging out, Daeyoung secretly joined and went to Sunghyeon's house together, but—

"Ah, bastards. Why the hell are you sneaking in at this time?"
"I came because I was wondering what you were doing. You weren't answering me."
"Fucking annoying. Why did you barge in without telling. Are you brain-dead?"
"What?"

I came to know the "true" side of Sunghyeon who was always kind to me.

[To: Stuckup Scholar
If I find your hideout, I'll let you know!
From: Cute Daeyoung]

description.en:
A man born with the temperament of a hero, but unable to showcase his talent due to a lack of opportunity, is stuck in a state of inferiority and defeatism, forever aspiring to be a hero.

He dismisses other heroes as shallow, kitschy sellouts, while proudly believing himself to be a true hero in the making.

One day, after being scammed and forced to take out a loan from a loan shark, he reluctantly enters a hero audition— the epitome of the kitsch he so despises.

Will he become kitsch, or will he rise to become a true Übermensch hero?
description.fr:
Un homme né avec le tempérament d'un héros, mais incapable de mettre en valeur son talent faute d'opportunités, est prisonnier d'un état d'infériorité et de défaitisme, aspirant sans cesse à devenir un héros.

Il rejette les autres héros, les qualifiant de vendus superficiels et kitsch, tout en se croyant fièrement un véritable héros en devenir.

Un jour, après avoir été escroqué et contraint de contracter un prêt auprès d'un usurier, il se présente à contrecœur à une audition de héros – l'incarnation même du kitsch qu'il méprise tant.

Deviendra-t-il kitsch, ou deviendra-t-il un véritable héros Übermensch?

description.en:
Only on the verge of death did I realize I'd been deceived my entire life by my perfect twin sister. Shocked by the betrayal, I wished I could just close my eyes... but when I opened my eyes, I was back in my childhood!? 

I had to pretend to be a princess with my sister without letting her know I was a twin! Now that I'm back, I won't just live like in my past life, being taken advantage of by my sister. The relationship with my family I'd longed for, the friendships I had with my friends, the healing power I hadn't realized in my past life. I'll make then all mine! 

Then, by chance, I met the talking bird, Yan. He told me that if I didn't protect him, the kingdon would fall. 

What did he mean? Will I be able to survive?
___
Just before dying, Princess Lillyn learns her perfect twin sister had deceived her all her life. Shocked by the betrayal, she opens her eyes to find she’s returned to childhood. This time, she's determined not to repeat her fate—and with a talking bird warning of ruin, she must fight to stay alive.

description.en:
It was a miserable day. 
She lived a life where she could not die. 
Rat, who lived in the slums, was in danger of being sold to a perverted nobleman. 

“P-Please save me…!” 

Her first attempt at rebellion was easily thwarted, and she wondered if she would die like this. 

“You’re safe now.” 

She is saved by a man she meets for the first time. 
And a fantasy-like life is given to her. 
She gets to know her parents, who she thought never existed, and reclaims her real name, Irina. 
Among the kind-hearted people of the Winfried family, Irina heals her wounds and grows little by little. 

“Miss Irina, make sure you’re happy here.” 

The man who saved her, Duke Logan Winfried. 
Irina falls in love with him as if it were already set in place. 

But why? 
Why do I feel empty somewhere even though our hearts are connected? 
Why do you look so distressed? 

“You said you wanted me to be happy.” 

So do I.
I want you to be happy too.

In her vids, she shares her love of poetry yet never her own face, because — let’s be honest — people are the worst, especially on the internet. I didn't even know that they were dating but marriage ?! " Yoona knew that the person Minhae liked was Kanghyun .  " I lived diligently  , only clinging to work , with the determination to succeed but the result was betrayal from my best friend and broken heart. One-day, on her way back home from work , Minhae stumbles upon her cat , Marie and runs into the driveway to save the cat and meets with an accident. " Right after the accident what I remember is the flashing headlights and the floating sensation . When I opened my eyes , I thought " Am I going to die like this.?! " I returned to a year and a half before the car accident . I will live differently this time. I'll balance my work life and confess before it's too late. Manager Kwon Joohyuk , who had nothing to do with Minhae in her previous life ; began to show interest in her this time. This is a story about creating a new life for Minhae who accidentally returned to the past..... Will she get her crush this time?

How do you distinguish between the love from a cute neighborhood girl (who’s like a little sister to you), and the love from the hottest, yet quirky, girl in school? This is exactly the question Myung-Ho has to ponder when both his neighbor’s cute little daughter, Ji-Hae, and his school’s most popular diva, Yu-Ri, make him their valentines. Of course he cares for Ji-Hae, because the poor girl’s already been through so much for someone her age, but still, she’s only just a kid. Then there’s Yu-Ri, the girl of his dreams…or rather, she would be if she wasn’t a fortune-telling voodoo witch doctor. Oh and yes, it would also help if her father, the local gangster boss, wasn’t out to kill him.  
  
When you’re as lucky as Myung-Ho is(?) choices are very hard to make. On one hand, he could go out with Yu-Ri by turning down Ji-Hae, breaking the heart of a child who’s been depending on him ever since she moved in next door. Or, he could choose Ji-Hae by turning down the only chance at romance with a beautiful girl dead set on making him her destined love. Choices, choices…

However... Out of nowhere, the man her sister intended to marry, Duke Kilian Janssen, suddenly declared that he would marry Cecilia. Moreover, his voice seemed to overlap with a voice she had heard a long time ago.

전생의 기억을 간직한 채 백작가의 사생아, 세실리아로 환생했다.

자기 의지대로 살지 못했던 예전 삶은 이미 오래 전 끝난 일이었다.

전생에 그녀가 무엇이었든, 지금은 적녀인 언니의 시녀로 사는 것.
이것이 백작가의 사생아로 환생한 세실리아의 삶이었다.

그런데...
언니가 결혼하려는 남자, 킬리엔 야닉센 대공이 뜬금없이 세실리아와 혼인하겠노라 선언한다.

심지어 그 사람의 목소리에서 아주 오래전 들었던 목소리가 자꾸 겹쳐진다.

"당신 때문에 화가 나서 도무지 견딜 수가 없어요."

"...거부할 테면 해 보세요. 나는 반드시 당신과 혼인할 거니까."

전생과 똑같은 수법으로 다가오는 남자.
그의 끈질긴 요구와 집착이 자꾸만 과거의 삶을 떠오르게 하는데...

과연 세실리아는 과거의 아픔을 치유하고 자신의 진정한 삶과 사랑을 찾을 수 있을까?

Seit dieser Heirat geht alles drunter und drüber und ihr perfektes, stolzes Leben wird zum reinen Chaos. description.en: Workaholic Lee Dain, the dazzling actress and national goddess, never saw herself walking down the aisle. But when her grandfather falls ill, she grants his final wish by marrying her failed one-night-stand, Seo Dojun. Suddenly, her life spins into chaos: handling wacky in-laws, dodging a junior actor's advances, and dealing with her hubby's ex. Armed with her trademark confidence and sass, she's ready to take it all on. But will this rollercoaster marriage ever find its happily ever after?

Elle lives in "Full House," the house that her architect father built before passing away a few years ago. She loves the place, but one day, people come to kick her out, claiming that the place now belongs to the famous actor Ryder Baye.

The afterlife! Once someone goes in they can never make it out alive! Snow White journeyed to the spirit world with the pass to the spirit world her mom left her to find her dad’s spirit but…  
  
“To lose my love, or to kill her, those are the two choices I’m faced with.”  
The blood loving and cold, absolute devil, Pa Sun.  
  
The one who wishes to protect Snow White’s happiness but must take her life, Tae San.  
"I no longer have the right to be by your side, I love you.  
Holding those feelings in my heart, I leave you for your sake."  
  
Will our kind and lovely Snow White’s jealous sister Oori’s curse follow her to the afterlife…?

On her way to her new school, she encounters a super model fighting another guy, using a special power, which seems to be the one Jiyoung’s grandfather had been talking about.  
Unfortunately, she gets involuntarily involved in the fight, and even meets them at her new school. She gets to know they are psychics, called Trumps (or Cards) who have special talents, and mingling with them, she realizes she also has a special power.   
Is she also a Trump, or even the Rule?

description.en:
A five-year employee at Hanpyeong Industries, Kim Yi-Wol, a proxy fan of his manager's daughter, has been working unpaid overtime as a proxy fan for five years. 

He collapses after hearing the news of his group's disbandment. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself back in his 20s, with no dark circles under his eyes. He's given the task of invalidating his sister's death by having to debut with the group he proxy-fancied, Spark. 

Failure is met with the dreaded additional condition: re-employment at Hanpyeong Industries and the inability to change jobs. 

With the grim determination and grit honed through his experience as a proxy fan, HR team member, and various other chores, he's determined to debut and then quit!
description.fr:
Le calvaire d’un salarié ordinaire faisant ses débuts comme idole

Kim Iwol, employé de cinquième année chez Hanpyeong Industries et fan dévoué (par obligation) depuis cinq ans à cause de la fille de son chef de département, vit une double vie.

Un soir, alors qu’il fait encore des heures supplémentaires non payées à cause de sa "passion" de fan, il apprend la nouvelle de la dissolution de son groupe préféré et s’évanouit.

À son réveil, il a retrouvé ses vingt ans, sans cernes, et se voit confier une mission : faire ses débuts dans le groupe « Spark », celui même qu’il admirait autrefois — en échange, la mort de sa sœur sera annulée.

S’il échoue, il devra réintégrer Hanpyeong Industries sans possibilité de changer d’emploi.

Fort de ses années d’expérience en ressources humaines, en petits boulots et en fanatisme de bureau, il se jure :
« Je ferai mes débuts, puis je me barre aussitôt ! »

This is the novel Leivella wakes up in, but she’s not the princess. Instead, she’s a mere extra whose family was framed and slaughtered by the tyrannical emperor. Now serving as the princess’s food taster who tests for poison, Leivella must find a way to avoid meeting a tragic death of her own. The world may revolve around its protagonist, but the unmentioned extra might have a shot at writing her own fate!
description.id: Suatu hari, Reibler mendapati dirinya terjebak di dalam tubuh bangsawan miskin di novel penyembuhan populer. Seharusnya itu adalah kisah tentang seorang putri cantik yang berakhir bahagia, tapi mengapa dia mengalami kehidupan yang sulit? Ayahnya yang menentang tirani dari kaisar dieksekusi dengan alasan pengkhianatan. Karena itu, Reibler nyaris tidak lolos dari kematian. Mengambil keuntungan dari fakta bahwa dia adalah karakter kecil, dia mencoba meninggalkan kekaisaran untuk menemukan akhir hidupnya yang bahagia, yang sama sekali tidak disebutkan dalam novel. Tapi dari semua orang, dia akhirnya disukai oleh tokoh utama dalam cerita ini, sang Putri...!
description.ko:
어느 날 힐링 육아물 속 엑스트라에 빙의했다.

description.ru:
В этом произведении читатели погружаются в мир, полный противоречий и тёмных тайн. Главный герой, закоренелая жертва печальной судьбы, находит себя в окружении жестокого тирана, чья одержимость привела к странным событиям. Несмотря на все прописанные правила и условности, персонаж не может избавиться от ощущения, что его жизнь стала бесконечной чередой мучений. Он задаётся вопросом, почему именно он стал жертвой этого безумного мира, где даже его собственный отец, охваченный ужасом, умолял об избавлении.

В один из странных дней его дочь, проявив неожиданную нежность, окрестила его "папой". Это событие стало тем самым триггером, который запустил цепочку абсурдных обвинений и постановлений. Тиран, попытавшись создать национальный праздник в честь этой мелочи, лишь усугубил ситуацию.

Отношения с императорской семьей постепенно становятся всё более напряжёнными, и главный герой начинает осознавать, что единственный выход — это бегство. Однако, даже за пределами стен замка его подстерегают опасности, и ему уже неясно, удастся ли ему выжить в этом мире, полном интриг и предательства. Вопрос о выживании становится актуальным, и читатели едва ли могут предсказать, чем закончится его попытка уйти от этого ада.

description.en: Seo Jaewoo wakes up to find himself in the world of a BL novel. But he isn’t just any random person. He’s actually the lousy side top character who’s meant to torment the main bottom, Yoo Hyeonjin. What’s worse is that by the novel’s conclusion, all of Jaewoo’s despicable actions catch up to him, and he is killed by the story’s crazy main top and Hyeonjin’s love interest, Choi Mujin. In order to avoid his death, Jaewoo decides to change his original role and get on Hyeonjin’s good side. His method: lure him in with food, of course! While his tactic proves effective and he slowly befriends Hyeonjin, that doesn’t become the only major change to the plot. After an unexpected encounter with Mujin, Jaewoo’s position as the “lousy side top” gets completely flipped upside down…

Why does Alfred insist on living as an outcast?  
And why does Hollie try so hard to keep him company?  
Is there something going on between the two?

When Shin Woo-Kyung was forced to take on the role of team leader for the troublesome Planning Team 2, one thought stuck in her mind: 
Gu Jung-Ha, who she constantly found in her personal life.

Woo-Kyung tried her best to endure and lead her team, but just when she was about to give up, the high-and-mighty nepotism hire began to change. More specifically, the way he looked at Woo-Kyung did.

Saerim Lee gets into an accident and loses her memory as a result. When she goes to school, she realizes that everyone is afraid of her, even her two best friends, who tell her that she was a very mean girl who blackmailed people, using their secrets against them. But she realizes that she can order people around because she supposedly knows these secrets, all of which were forgotten in the car crash. She only has one connection to the person she was in the past, and that is her diary. In it, she wrote of the person she was in love with, but never his name. She will stop at nothing to discover his identity!

description.en:
The cherished youngest daughter of the prestigious Jujak clan, Jeok Soya, is suddenly exposed as a fake.

“Strip her of her spirit core and lock her in the Cold Palace.”

Though her heart ached from her family’s cruelty and cold rejection, she endured it.
After all, she was just a wicked little fledgling who had deceived them and brought them sorrow.

“Please… get rid of that child.”

But even so, accepting death was a different matter entirely.

“What is this… little fluff ball?”

At the brink of danger, the one who saves Soya is a ferocious tiger—
No… the head of the Baekho clan.

“I think I’ll steal you, little fluff.”

Accepting his suspicious offer, Soya follows him to the land of Baekho.
She plans to live quietly, never drawing attention… but something about this clan is strange.

“Don’t worry, you’re no trouble at all. Stay here as long as you like.”

The clan head, infamous for his brutality, is unexpectedly gentle.

“Try calling me ‘Oppa,’ Soya.”
“Me too! I’m your oppa now, fluff ball!”

The young masters of the Baekho clan compete to become her older brothers.
And strangest of all—

“Our little fluff lady is just too adorable!”
“Hmph! Bet your old house didn’t have a fluff this cute, huh?”

“…Me? Cute? Not useless and dreadful?”
description.fr:
So-Ya était la fille chérie du prestigieux clan JEOK (l'Oiseau Vermillon)... du moins, c’est ce qu’elle croyait jusqu’au jour de sa première transformation. Au lieu des majestueuses plumes rouges attendues, elle se retrouve couverte d'un duvet blanc comme la neige : une simple petite boule de poils.

Traitée de "fausse" fille et de honte pour le clan, elle est dépouillée de son noyau spirituel et jetée dans un palais glacé. Alors qu'elle attend une mort certaine, elle est sauvée par un homme qu'on dit terrifiant : le chef du clan BAEKHO (le Tigre Blanc). « Je vais te voler, petite boule de coton », déclare-t-il. Emmenée sur les terres des tigres, So-Ya s'attend au pire, mais elle découvre des gens... étrangement protecteurs et gagas de sa mignonnerie !
description.ko:
소야는 주작 가문의 금지옥엽 막내딸이었다.
적어도… 첫 수인화를 하는 날 전까지는.

주작의 직계라면 누구나 가진다는 붉은 깃털 대신,
몸에 돋아난 건 눈처럼 새하얀 솜털.

“영핵을 빼앗고, 냉궁에 가두어라.”

그날 이후, 소야는 사랑받는 막내딸에서 냉대와 핍박을 받는 가문의 수치가 되었다. 게다가 결국 진짜 주작 가문의 딸 ‘리리’가 돌아오자
말 그대로 버려지고 만다.

죽음을 눈앞에 둔 그 순간―

“뭐냐, 이 솜뭉치는.”

위기의 순간, 소야를 구해 준 것은 새하얀 백호 가문의 가주님이었다.

“널 훔쳐야겠다, 솜뭉치.”

수상한 제안을 받아들여 백호의 땅으로 가게 된 소야.
이곳에서는 절대 눈에 띄지 않고 조용히 살고 싶었는데,
백호 가문 사람들이 지나치게 상냥하다?!

"우리, 어디서 만난 적 있지 않아요?"

서로를 알기 전, 이미 몇 번의 만남이 있었던 우연과 예하.
둘은 우연의 퍼즐을 모아 관계를 완성할 수 있을까?
평생 엇갈릴 것만 같았던 둘이 세 번째 접점을 계기로 시작하게 되는 캠퍼스 로맨스.

Lee Seunghyun, a man who was suddenly dumped by the girlfriend he had expected to marry. And the man at the forefront of his troubles—Yoon Yisun, his junior at work who's rumored to be her new fling.
Seunghyun does everything he can to avoid Yisun, but slowly begins to open his heart to the man who finds a way to be with him at every turn.

In Warcraft: The Sunwell Trilogy, a good-natured but brash blue dragon, Tyrygosa, and the human Jorad Mace, a paladin struggling to reconnect with the Light, emerged victorious in the Ghostlands after ending the undead Scourge's quest to obtain the Sunwell's potent energies. Yet as arduous as that task was, Tyri and Jorad's journey is far from over. Both are drawn into the Dark Portal and transported to the shattered world of Outland, where they encounter a group of enigmatic creatures unlike any they have ever seen: the incorporeal nether dragons. Observing everything is the ruthless Ragnok Bloodreaver, one of the original death knights created prior to the Second War. This undead terror has dark plans for the nether dragons, and if his agenda comes to pass, all of Outland, including Tyri and Jorad, will suffer.

At Midsummer High, Yeon-Su Guk is at the top of her class, while Wung Choi is ranked dead-last. And it’s not just their grades -- their personalities couldn’t be more different, as Yeon-Su is a no-nonsense stickler and Wung is a care-free slacker. When a filmmaker comes to make a documentary about their school life over the course of a month, they’re not exactly thrilled to be spending so much time together. However, as the month goes on, they begin to discover each other’s hidden depths. At least one thing’s for certain - they’ll never forget this summer!

Note:

This webtoon is a prequel to the Kdrama, Our Beloved Summer, the webtoon will focus on Choi Wung and Guk Yeonsu in their high school days.
